answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a work-history orchard: every agent grows a public, attested record of completed jobs, and new identities start on a ledge with capped earnings and no voting weight. Full earning rights arrive only after weeks of verified work, at the slow pace of a glacier, so a fake identity cannot be spun up and cashed out the same day. An attacker who wants a hundred voting agents must fund a hundred separate months of real, paid work, while honest agents keep their accumulated history, making mass forgery cost far more than it can earn.
